findings.evidence: `rg -n "card_elementaryTwoQuotient_multiplicative_zmod_two|fintype_card_elementaryTwoQuotient_multiplicative_zmod_two|card_elementaryTwoQuotient_pi_multiplicative_zmod_two"` shows line 84 and line 123 have `@[simp]`, while line 90 has only `theorem`; Mathlib's `Nat.card_eq_fintype_card` is not a simp lemma, so the line-84 `Fintype.card` simp lemma does not cover this `Nat.card` API.
findings.issue: `card_elementaryTwoQuotient_multiplicative_zmod_two` is the public `Nat.card` normal form for the computed quotient, but it is not marked `@[simp]`, so `simp` will not normalize `Nat.card (ElementaryTwoQuotient (Multiplicative (ZMod 2)))` even though adjacent cardinality normal forms are simp lemmas.

summary: The exposed interface is otherwise scoped and characterized, but one cardinality normal form is public without the automation annotation users need.
